source: Direct creator update 2026-11-25; radio production feedback: five or six tracks sound like the same beat with changed text; Universal repair unsatisfactory

native_relations.function: static_repetition counterrelation; preserve recurrence with transformation
optional dynamic chapters, variation and contrast

semantic_requirements: no unwanted digital crackle or artifacts
mastering.compact_example: Club-ready master, maximum clean loudness 🔊, punchy transients, tight mono sub, clear separation, preserved dynamics, no clipping, no overcompression or digital artifacts.

comparison.scope: recent distinct productions, prioritize last 5–6 where available; include closer relevant earlier baseline
comparison.compare: For each axis cite concrete musical cues from both final prompt pairs; classify SAME, MEANINGFULLY_DIFFERENT, MIXED, or UNKNOWN. Compare musical function, not adjective synonyms. Missing reference never counts as difference. Beat includes kick pattern and timbre; bass includes subdivision, articulation, pitch motion and rests; groove includes accents and percussion timing.
comparison.hold: If beat/bass/groove are substantially repeated with no meaningful arrangement or dynamic distinction, HOLD and redesign before production output. Changing only lyric, BPM, genre labels or synth names cannot clear repeated motor. Preserve intentional creator-requested continuity, explicitly record it. No fixed rotation, no compulsory count of changed axes, no automatic BPM changes.
comparison.missing: PARTIAL_REFERENCE; report actual count and missing fields; do not claim diversity verified; recover exact prior prompts if available; no invented history.
comparison.output: Per-track concrete evidence and rationale; prompt review distinct from actual audio comparison; no numerical audio similarity without measurement.

radio.recommendation: Audition or separate audio QC before rotation; do not automatically modify radio.
